quest.title: Aragaru's Drawing
quest.description: You helped Aragaru defeat the Eremites in Chatrakam Cave. Their goal, however, seems to be related to a friendship that Aragaru has forgotten...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x200, Primogem x30, Mora x20000, Hero's Wit x2

dialogues.speaker: Aragaru
dialogues.text: Golden Nara and White Floaty, you are here again!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whoa! Say hello before jumping out next time! You scared Paimon again!

response.speaker: Aragaru
response.text: Hmph... You're right... So, Golden Nara and White Floaty who don't look like bad guys, could you do me a favor?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: And Paimon is Paimon, don't forget that again!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #We have been here with you, but you forgot it all... Ugh, too much explanation! {NICKNAME}, why don't we do that together?

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: You describe your adventure with Aragaru in detail.

response.speaker: Aragaru
response.text: Is that so...? I can't remember, but I somehow want to believe you... And you have the flower I gave, I can feel her.

response.speaker: Aragaru
response.text: Ah, right! The bad Nara set up a campsite. Let's see what they left there. Maybe we could know their plans!

choices.text: We chased the bad guys away for you.

dialogues.speaker: Aragaru
dialogues.text: How is it? Did you find anything?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hmm... Nothing but vague orders, and this! A dried flower!

dialogues.speaker: Aragaru
dialogues.text: Eh...! This flower, can I have it?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: That's from the bad guys, aren't you afraid of getting poisoned... or something like that?

dialogues.speaker: Aragaru
dialogues.text: No need to worry, I have seen the flower before... The person, I should know... Please give it to me, okay?

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: Aragaru brought the little dried flower to Mawtiyima Forest...

dialogues.speaker: Aragaru
dialogues.text: Let's go to the bad Nara's campsite and find out what they're up to!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: How can you tell if someone's bad?

dialogues.speaker: Aragaru
dialogues.text: #Well, I can't really explain it, but Nara {NICKNAME} and White Floaty are not baddies for sure! I believe that!
